biography.plain_text: The City of Rijeka is Croatia’s principal port city and a local-government institution with elected and administrative bodies. Its mayor, City Council and municipal departments exercise the city’s statutory responsibilities and deliver local services. The name represents the municipality as a continuing public body, rather than any mayor, councillor or municipal employee.

long_biography.plain_text:
Rijeka’s municipal government combines elected representation with professional administration. The City Council adopts local decisions and oversees matters within the municipality’s authority, while the mayor performs executive functions and directs implementation through the city administration.

Administrative departments manage responsibilities such as local development, services, finance and other statutory municipal work. Mayors and councillors change through elections, but the City of Rijeka continues as a Croatian local-government body with its own legal identity and public duties. The name refers to that municipality today, not to any individual mayor, councillor or employee.
